svg.aria-label: The DataAgentBench leaderboard set and its golden SQL coverage: 54 questions over 12 datasets in four engines, 8.4 GB loaded into one Postgres schema of 2,811 tables. One cell per question, filled where the golden recreates the gold answer exactly (36), grey where it passes the validator but differs from the gold text (8) or is an evidence golden for a judgment question (5), hollow where no golden exists yet (5: agnews 1 to 4 and crmarenapro 7). Written by hand in the Golden tab, run as the agent role and judged by each question's own validator.
svg.title: 49 of 54 questions have a golden statement; 36 recreate the gold exactly, and agnews has none
